Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to follow up with a technical deep-dive specifically focused on performance/latency benchmarking so we can validate throughput targets before contract signature. High-level asks:

- Walkthrough of your load-test plan and tooling (what harness you use, observability hooks).
- Confirmation of token/sec and tail-latency expectations for the model family we discussed.
- A brief run through of KV-cache warmup behavior and recommended pre-warm steps.

Our target peak for pilot is ~180k tokens/min (sustained for 10m windows) with 95th-percentile latency below 350ms for 128-token responses. I've attached our rough token profile and SLA requirements for reference.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical session next week? Timezone: PST. Best windows for our infra & execs are: Oct 30 11:00–12:30 or Oct 30 14:00–15:30.

Thanks — appreciate a pointer to any pre-reads you want us to prepare.

—Alice

Thanks, Jasmine / Alice —

Quick technical note before we lock times: the 180k tokens/min sustained for 10 minutes is achievable but depends on two things we should confirm ahead of the call:

- Model variant: are you targeting the 30B quantized family (q4) or the 13B fp16 variant? The 30B q4 has better token/sec cost for long sequences but can have slightly higher tail-latency under KV cache misses.
- Request mix: percentage of 128-token vs 512-token responses and proportion of streaming vs non-streaming calls.

For staging, we should reserve one dedicated pod set in our staging cluster with the same GPU class you plan to use in production. Marissa, can you confirm capacity and whether we can reserve a slot on Oct 30 afternoon?

Also, we'll need Evonix to provide a small sample of request traces (anonymized) to bake into the harness. The sample can be a CSV mapping prompt length -> response length to build realistic inter-arrival and sequence-length distributions.

-Karthik
